scope.summary: Implement corrective validation (spec 13.19 validation clause; PREQ-014, REQ-018): register the BODY_POSE_RANGE_VALID descriptor in the 13.15 runner proving the acceptance-archetype x QA-pose matrix renders without collapse, pinch, or interpenetration, with typed findings and Argus capture refs.
acceptance_criteria: BODY_POSE_RANGE_VALID descriptor registered per 13.15 runner/stage discipline: evaluates correctives across the archetype x QA-pose matrix and asserts zero collapse/pinch/interpenetration findings.
Typed findings name archetype, pose, region, and metric (self-intersection count, min triangle area, volume deviation) with a suggested_fix pointer.
Matrix results persist machine-readable with Argus capture refs attached for visual verification of each cell.
The descriptor is consumable by BkBodiesQA (MT-642) without re-implementation.
scope.risk_if_missed: Without a registered BODY_POSE_RANGE_VALID gate, corrective coverage is asserted by hand and archetype x pose regressions slip through silently; MT-642's QA matrix would have to invent an ad-hoc duplicate check.

target_entries: Tailor UserManual > BodyKit morphs and correctives

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: This MT owns authoritative, job, or external-tool lifecycle events and must project the same event_id, run_id, actor_id, and correlation_id from EventLedger into Flight Recorder.
This MT emits typed diagnostics through its owning command or job and inherits retention, health, and projection behavior from the shared diagnostics substrate.
The owning native shell or scheduled job supplies Palmistry coverage; this MT must preserve operation identity and recovery handles.

risks: Broad MT scope can hide multiple review targets.
Markdown MT lists may disagree with packet-declared active/next MT truth.
Receipt routing may target an old MT if contract identity is omitted.
minimum_controls: Exactly one primary proof target per MT unless the packet records why not.
MT identity must be stable and referenced by receipt correlation.
Generated projection drift must not wake Coder or Validator by itself.

required_changes_before_execution: Consume the signed technical refinement, canonical command/surface registries, classified HBR tiers, and task-oriented UserManual contract before execution.
